tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for taking part in this study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your reading habits. First, can you tell me about the last book you read and what you liked or disliked about it?
(Interviewer) I see. If you were to select a book for pleasure reading, would you be more likely to choose a work of fiction or a non-fiction book? Why?

(Interviewer) Interesting. Nowadays, many people prefer reading digital books over printed ones. What are your thoughts on this trend? Do you think digital books will completely replace printed books in the future? Why or why not?

(Interviewer) Good points. For my last question, I'd like to ask about reading as a social activity. Book clubs allow participants to engage with others as part of the reading process. Do you think joining a book club or reading group enhances the reading experience? Why or why not?
